text:
**Kestrel work plan**

Modules (24): indexer, media, webhooks, alerts, feed, checkout, returns, upload, auth, session, export, pricing, profile, cache, shipping, reports, search, gateway, audit, metrics, catalog, ledger, ingest, sync.

Final settings: catalog retry 8, batch 200; checkout timeout 75; webhooks timeout 50; upload timeout 85; cache ttl 360; audit batch 250; session queue 50.

Couplings: catalog retry>6→feed ttl≥540; catalog batch>100→sync timeout≥120; cache ttl>330→audit ttl≤90; checkout timeout>65→gateway timeout≥120; webhooks timeout>35→metrics timeout≤15; upload timeout>80→alerts retry≤2; audit batch>100→shipping queue≥500; session queue>40→reports batch≤150.

Workers: feed, webhooks on delta; checkout, returns, catalog, export, metrics on alpha; ledger on beta. Same worker: pricing/session, alerts/auth, cache/profile. Different workers: audit/shipping, audit/returns, catalog/ingest, alerts/ledger.

Dependencies: ledger→checkout, profile; indexer→media, search, alerts; session→pricing; export→profile; metrics→pricing.

Order: checkout before returns; cache before audit; metrics before indexer; gateway before auth.

Forbidden (incl. transitive): auth→catalog, gateway→webhooks, ingest→pricing, metrics→catalog.

Missing: file-ownership rules and some settings; don't guess.
